{{Top|leg}}
The '''Room of Dark Knowledge''' was a room that was located inside the [[Temple of Pain]], a [[Sith temple/Legends|Sith Temple]] situated within the [[Tascollan Nebula/Legends|Tascollan Nebula]]. The room served as a library, containing [[Book/Legends|books]] and scrolls on the subject of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] lore.
